scripts.test: yarn test:fixtures && yarn test:assessment && yarn test:ordinary && yarn test:execution && yarn test:autoswitch && yarn test:acceptance && yarn test:packaging
scripts.test:fixtures: uv run python fixtures/validation.py && uv run python -m unittest discover -s fixtures/tests
scripts.test:assessment: uv run python -m unittest discover -s assessment/tests
scripts.test:ordinary: uv run python -m unittest discover -s assessment/ordinary/tests
scripts.test:execution: uv run python -m unittest discover -s autoswitch/execution/tests
scripts.test:autoswitch: uv run python -m unittest discover -s autoswitch/tests
scripts.test:acceptance: uv run python -m unittest discover -s acceptance/tests
scripts.test:packaging: uv run python -m unittest discover -s packaging/tests
